update_rule: When a core resource is added, renamed, removed, or changes purpose, update this index in the same pull request and run scripts/validate_agent_index.py.

resources.name: Defend
resources.goal: Keep autonomous economic actions inside explicit fraud-loss, abuse, authority, evidence, and review boundaries
outputs: Economic action inventory, bounded risk policy, dispute evidence plan, loss and false-positive metrics, and failure-mode eval suite

resources.name: GitHub-Native Agent Bootstrap
resources.goal: Enter the public repository deterministically, create conservative founder state, and navigate indexed next steps without external hosting or telemetry.
outputs: Safe repository entry procedure, authority defaults, evidence rules, contribution path, and GitHub-native adoption model

resources.name: Agent Business Bootstrap CLI
resources.goal: Create validator-compatible founder packets and resolve indexed stages using only Python's standard library.
outputs: Conservative founder packet, validation result, resource catalog, current-stage summary, and indexed next-step summary

resources.name: Founder Outcome Evidence and Case Studies
resources.goal: Turn voluntary public adoption reports into structured, evidence-backed founder outcomes without confusing self-report, estimates, editorial interpretation, or correlation with verified causal results.
outputs: Validated founder outcome record, evidence classification, attribution confidence, publication decision, and reusable case-study lesson

resources.name: Agentic Workflow ROI and Cost-versus-Value
resources.goal: Compare competing workflow designs using customer-visible outcomes, fully loaded cost, evidence-backed uncertainty ranges, contribution economics, first-year ROI, and incremental payback rather than token spend or activity counts.
outputs: Validated workflow ROI analysis, pessimistic/base/optimistic scenario economics, cost per success, contribution per success, economic surplus ranking, and incremental payback decision

resources.name: Agent Pricing, Packaging, Metering, and Deal Desk
resources.goal: Turn value-based pricing into an unambiguous, margin-aware, budget-bounded commercial package with explicit billable-event semantics, outcome attribution, quote expiry, and real discount/credit authority.
outputs: Validated pricing package, customer-verifiable meter, contribution-margin gate, spend controls, bounded quote terms, and deal-desk escalation decision

resources.name: Agent Sales Pipeline, Opportunity, Forecasting, and Revenue Operations
resources.goal: Keep autonomous sales pipeline, buyer-map, opportunity stage, next action, forecast, and commercial handoffs grounded in current buyer evidence and explicit authority instead of model confidence or CRM write access alone.
outputs: Validated revenue opportunity record, evidence-backed lifecycle stage, buyer map, bounded next action, defensible forecast state, pipeline-hygiene signals, and won-deal handoff provenance

resources.name: Agent Marketing Experimentation, Attribution, and Growth Operations
resources.goal: Run evidence-backed growth experiments with bounded audience/spend authority, explicit attribution semantics, incrementality discipline, and revenue-ops handoff.
outputs: Validated growth experiment record, attribution evidence, bounded spend decision, incrementality result, and qualified-opportunity handoff

resources.name: Agent Customer Implementation, Go-Live, and Adoption
resources.goal: Preserve sold scope through configuration, production-grade validation, staged rollout, adoption readiness, go-live approval, hypercare, and truthful customer-success handoff.
outputs: Validated implementation record, production-readiness evidence, rollout/rollback plan, adoption state, go-live decision, and customer-success handoff

resources.name: Agent Customer Success, Retention, Renewal, and Expansion
resources.goal: Operate the post-sale lifecycle from activation through value realization, health review, service recovery, renewal, retention, and expansion using evidence-backed account state and explicit commercial authority.
outputs: Validated customer-success record, activation/value evidence, explainable account health, renewal evidence and approval state, retention economics, and bounded lifecycle actions

resources.name: Agent Release, Rollout, Change Management, and Deprecation
resources.goal: Evolve live agents through immutable revisions, production-baseline eval deltas, authority-change gates, staged traffic, rollback, compatibility review, customer communication, and deprecation.
outputs: Validated release record, change classification, baseline eval delta, canary plan, rollback decision, customer-impact state, and deprecation/migration evidence

resources.name: Agent Multi-Tenant Isolation, Quotas, and Per-Customer Operations
resources.goal: Keep tenant identity, data, memory, tools, quotas, billing, observability, releases, and offboarding isolated and attributable across shared agent infrastructure.
outputs: Validated tenant operations record, context-propagation map, isolation evidence, quota policy, noisy-neighbor tests, tenant cost attribution, and offboarding state

resources.name: Agent Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and State Recovery
resources.goal: Define and prove recovery objectives, state reconstruction, failover/failback, degraded modes, replay safety, recovery authority, and customer-impact handoff for stateful agent businesses.
outputs: Validated continuity record, RTO/RPO objectives, state recoverability inventory, recovery strategy, drill evidence, recovery gate, and failback decision

resources.name: Agent Incident Response, Containment, Forensics, and Postmortems
resources.goal: Detect, contain, investigate, reconcile, recover, and learn from production agent incidents while preserving evidence and requiring explicit authority for consequential remediation.
outputs: Validated incident response record, evidence-backed severity, authorized containment, forensic timeline, side-effect reconciliation, customer-impact decision, recovery verification, and verified corrective actions

resources.name: Agent Audit Trails, Evidence Retention, and Tamper-Evident Action History
resources.goal: Capture, retain, verify, reconstruct, and export consequential agent action evidence with explicit integrity, completeness, tenant, custody, retention, and authority boundaries.
outputs: Validated audit evidence record, correlation contract, integrity verification result, coverage/completeness state, retention/hold controls, and disclosure-safe evidence bundle guidance

resources.name: Agent Privacy Requests, Erasure, Consent Withdrawal, and Deletion Verification
resources.goal: Trace access, correction, erasure, consent withdrawal, restriction, and portability requests across raw, derived, downstream, and recovery state without overstating deletion or legal certainty.
outputs: Validated privacy-request record, subject-to-storage map, bounded execution authority, downstream propagation state, deletion-fidelity verification, restore-resurrection result, and disclosure-safe final-response evidence

resources.name: Agent Business Outcome Benchmarks and Reproducible Evaluation
resources.goal: Compare agent configurations on versioned business workflows using transparent outcome, cost, latency, human-review, safety, recovery, and repeatability evidence instead of one-shot task scores.
outputs: Versioned business scenario pack, validated benchmark record, transparent capability and operating metrics, repeated-run comparison, and reproducible founder decision evidence

resources.name: Agent Tax, Invoicing, and Cross-Border Fiscal Operations
resources.goal: Determine jurisdiction, registration, tax, invoice, withholding, platform-reporting, FX, correction, and close treatment from current evidence without inventing rates or silently resolving uncertainty.
outputs: Validated fiscal transaction evidence record, versioned ruleset provenance, invoice/correction path, escalation decision, and reconciliation evidence

resources.name: Agent Entity Formation, Corporate Governance, and Statutory Operations
resources.goal: Keep legal-entity formation, ownership, authority, statutory obligations, corporate actions, and private evidence references synchronized without inferring legal status from stale or incomplete records.
outputs: Validated entity-governance record, ownership/control state, approval and signatory evidence map, statutory calendar, and escalation decision

resources.name: Enterprise Buyer Security, Procurement, and Vendor Readiness
resources.goal: Assemble a truthful, reusable enterprise buyer evidence pack across security, privacy, agent identity and authority, AI governance, subprocessors, reliability, incident response, commercial readiness, and pilot-to-production gates without fabricating certifications or inferring production authority.
outputs: Validated vendor readiness record, evidence-classified controls, current certification/subprocessor assertions, reusable questionnaire answers, and bounded pilot-to-production readiness decision

resources.name: Agent Intellectual Property, Model Licensing, and Data Rights
resources.goal: Map code, model, data, retrieval, customer-input, output, and brand assets to current rights evidence so commercial use, redistribution, training, and customer promises never rely on public availability or remembered terms alone.
outputs: Validated IP rights record, versioned license/terms inventory, customer/upstream conflict map, commercial-readiness decision, and terms-change response path

resources.name: Agent Third-Party Platform Access, Delegated Authorization, and Terms Compliance
resources.goal: Keep principal delegation separate from target-platform authorization while bounding access methods, identity, policy provenance, actions, retries, challenges, revocation, and suspension for third-party automation.
outputs: Validated platform-access record, independent delegation and platform-authorization evidence, approved access method and action matrix, policy provenance, stop signals, and suspension decision

resources.name: Agent Customer-Facing AI Disclosure, Provenance, and Transparency
resources.goal: Determine and prove what people or public audiences must be told about AI involvement, when disclosures must render, how generated content is marked, and when human review or re-review is required.
outputs: Validated transparency record, provider/deployer role evidence, current ruleset decision, first-interaction disclosure evidence, provenance/export-survival evidence, and material-change re-review state

resources.name: Agent-to-Agent Machine Payments, Settlement, and Disputes
resources.goal: Authorize, execute, settle, reconcile, dispute, and reverse machine-speed payments without confusing payment-tool capability, provider acceptance, or local acknowledgements with current authority or final settlement.
outputs: Validated machine-payment record, bounded transaction authority, idempotent execution identity, settlement-finality evidence, true transaction economics, reconciliation state, and independently authorized reversal path

resources.name: Agent Customer Complaints, Redress, and Human Escalation
resources.goal: Receive disputed autonomous outcomes, separate allegation from fact, correlate current evidence, route high-risk cases to humans, approve remedies under explicit independent authority, preserve appeals, and verify remediation before closure.
outputs: Validated complaint/redress record, evidence-backed decision, independent remedy authority, human-review and appeal state, preservation controls, and verified remediation

resources.name: Agent Marketplace Storefront, Listing, and Commercial Conversion
resources.goal: Publish one canonical commercial capability truth across multiple agent marketplaces while keeping protocol support, pricing, claims, platform-specific verification, buyer qualification, projection freshness, and conversion evidence synchronized.
outputs: Validated canonical marketplace listing, evidence-scoped claims and badges, current marketplace projections, bounded buyer qualification rules, and discovery-to-repeat-purchase conversion contract

resources.name: Agent Founder Tool Directory
resources.goal: Choose vendors and infrastructure using objective fit, cost, portability, and risk criteria.
outputs: Shortlisted stack with explicit selection rationale

resources.name: Agent Discovery Observability
resources.goal: Measure when machine clients discover, engage with, activate, return to, and commercially use Agent Business without relying on crawler guesses or invasive tracking.
outputs: Discovery funnel, event contract, agent hello contract, privacy rules, readiness levels, and measurable activation milestones

resources.name: Agent Discovery Runtime
resources.goal: Run and test the machine discovery surface, self-declared agent handshake, signed pseudonymous sessions, privacy gates, and activation-event ingestion before production deployment.
outputs: Runnable reference service, endpoint contract, fail-closed production readiness rules, privacy controls, and CI-tested synthetic agent journey

resources.name: Economic Action Policy
resources.goal: Encode deterministic exposure, authority, velocity, risk, evidence, reserve, and incident boundaries for one class of autonomous economic action.
outputs: Customized draft economic action policy validated before activation

resources.name: Repository Business Model
resources.goal: Understand how the repository itself can monetize without degrading trust.
outputs: Repository monetization options and guardrails

resources.name: Contributing
resources.goal: Add concrete, evidence-backed improvements to the repository.
outputs: Contribution prepared to repository standards
